tickets.title: Coordinate custodian security review and access restoration
tickets.text: Coordinate with Velvet Acorn Custody to address temporary online restrictions and the fraud review process for Helena Lanternmoss, following her request for support on the security incident call.
tickets.evidence: She requested Apricot Compass Advisory support on a call with Velvet Acorn Custody to address temporary online restrictions and the fraud review process; the agreed follow-up is due November 8, 2023.

tickets.title: Investigate unauthorized external bank link and trial credits
tickets.text: Investigate the source and reversal requirements for the two small trial credits labeled Buttonwood Balloon Payments and the pending external bank link found in the joint taxable account activity screen at Velvet Acorn Custody.
tickets.evidence: The source and any reversal requirements remain unresolved, with follow-up needed by November 10, 2023.

tickets.title: Gather custodian review evidence packet

tickets.evidence: the full alert emails, screenshots of the recovery phone notice, and the latest Velvet Acorn Custody message center note were not yet available to Apricot Compass Advisory for the custodian security file; the agreed follow-up is due November 9, 2023.

tickets.title: Complete household profile update
tickets.text: Refresh the household profile for Helena and Oliver Lanternmoss to include Ruth Lanternmoss as a new household member and update contact hierarchy to reflect Iris Lanternmoss as successor fiduciary and Oliver as primary fiduciary.

subTasks.title: Collect profile change information
subTasks.text: Request or compile updates for household members, addresses, contact preferences, employment, dependents, and major recent or expected life events.

subTasks.title: Update planning assumptions
subTasks.text: Revise income, savings, spending, retirement timing, education funding, and family support assumptions in the planning record as applicable.

subTasks.title: Identify advice impacts
subTasks.text: Flag changes that may affect tax planning, risk management, estate coordination, cash flow, or investment allocation recommendations.

subTasks.title: Confirm profile completion
subTasks.text: Review the updated profile for consistency and note any remaining open questions for the next client conversation.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is due November 17, 2023.

tickets.title: Review and update multifactor authentication settings
tickets.text: Update multifactor authentication and device safeguards for Helena Lanternmoss, Oliver Lanternmoss, and advisor-view permissions at Velvet Acorn Custody to replace SMS authentication with app-based authentication.
tickets.evidence: the custodial profile notes still referenced SMS authentication and did not show app-based authentication for Helena’s login, Oliver’s login, or advisor-view permissions; the agreed follow-up is due November 14, 2023.

tickets.title: Compare identity theft coverage renewal options
tickets.text: Compare identity theft coverage renewal options from Pocket Lantern Insurance for Helena Lanternmoss, specifically addressing the reimbursement cap below her expectation while the account security issue is being reviewed.
tickets.evidence: the Pocket Lantern Insurance renewal materials describe an identity theft endorsement with a reimbursement cap below Helena’s expectation, and the coverage choice remains unresolved while the account security issue is being reviewed, with follow-up needed by November 22, 2023.
